input.quote: 13.1 IBM assumes and will assume ownership and MSL assigns and will assign all intellectual and industrial property rights for hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products delivered under this Agreement
input.rationale: Ownership runs in our favour and meets the preferred position. Section 13.1 (p0197) has MSL assign to IBM all IP rights in the hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products delivered, and p0198 gives IBM ownership of MSL inventions on Products and on IBM processes/systems, with only a narrow carve-out letting MSL use such inventions in performing its obligations to us (an operational licence back to the vendor that does not prejudice us). Section 13.3(a) (p0208) confirms no rights or licences in IBM's pre-existing IP pass to MSL beyond a royalty-free right to use IBM confidential information solely to manufacture Products for IBM, with any further licence requiring a separate signed IBM agreement; §13.2 keeps IBM information under the AECI with a return-on-request right. Section 5 of the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement (p1530) keeps title to all Loaned Items with IBM. Nothing assigns IBM IP or IBM data to MSL, no vendor ownership of deliverables and no joint ownership appears (searches for "joint ownership" and "property of MSL" return nothing; p0947's "MSL will own the entire manufacturing and delivery process" is operational responsibility, not an IP grant). No redline required.
